method: premium_pct = (parallel buying midpoint / CBN selling rate - 1) x 100; not computed this edition because verified parallel observations were unavailable
parallel_source: Aggregated from multiple independent market sources
official_sources: Central Bank of Nigeria and national official reference tables
nigeria_market_note: Nigeria parallel-market ranges are not shown in this edition: fewer than two verifiable current independent observations per currency could be retrieved, so no range, midpoint or premium is published. CBN benchmarks shown are the latest available (13 Oct).
nigeria_market_note_short: Parallel ranges not sourced this edition; CBN benchmarks are 13 Oct.
markets_note: Latest verified official/reference values with effective dates: Ghana mid of Bank of Ghana buy/sell (13 Oct); Kenya CBK commercial-banks’ average closing rates (market close 13 Oct; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates at approximately 10:30 on 13 Oct (carried forward; endpoint unreachable 14 Oct); Egypt mid of CBE buy/sell (13 Oct, carried forward; CBE unreachable 14 Oct).
